summary: Sealed park car park by courts and open parkland; homes over 60 m away.
reasons: Car park backs onto park and courts
Plenty of bays for a van

best_section.where: Eastern bays of the car park south of the tennis courts, by the park path

drivers.seclusion: Faces parkland and a wetland; the nearest houses are on the hill 60-80 m to the north-west.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed access from Harley Street into marked bays; there is room to park a van off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Arterial road and motorway lie south, but the car park is set back and clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Public sports and park car park; a few cars, no vans or tents seen.

flags: Courts and playground nearby may mean evening use and lighting
Slope about 2% at the pin; DEM shows a steeper bank on the south edge
sun_shade: Open to sun; scattered trees shade the south and east edges.
